## Security

Does this touch authorisation, file handling, sessions, tokens, uploads or anything a viewer can reach? If so, say which rules in DESIGN.md and the security requirements apply, and which tests prove them.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and fail without it
- [ ] `uv run pre-commit run --all-files` passes
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has an entry under `[Unreleased]` (or this change needs none)
- [ ] Documentation is updated, in British English
- [ ] No new dependency, or one that was agreed first and passes the licence check
